_comment: Bounded transitional obligations for the DS-A003 parity census. NOT a ceiling: an obligation has one owner lot, an exact count, and a structural expiry, and it expires by being resolved rather than by being tolerated. It is a SIBLING of baseline/ and never a key inside it, because --update-baseline rewrites the baseline payload as {version,_comment,ceilings} and would erase anything else it carried. --update-baseline must never write this file, and must refuse to run while any obligation is open.
